entities.summary: Rona Barrett is a retired American TV News Correspondent, Interviewer,gossip columnist and businesswoman. She runs the Rona Barrett Foundation, a non-profit organization in Santa Ynez, California, dedicated to the aid and support of senior citizens in need.
